INDIA bloc to hold protest march demanding CEC's resignation

Leader of the opposition and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi-led INDIA bloc is going to march to the Supreme Court today at 4 p.m. local time (10:30 UTC), intensifying their agitation against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Gandhi urged people to join his "march for democracy" and "march for justice" in a post on X, as he gave the "Chalo Dilli" (Let's go to Delhi) call ahead of the INDIA bloc's planned march to the Supreme Court.
The call for the protest march came a day after forceful, mass detentions of protesters, journalists and lawyers were reported in Delhi on Saturday.
The Cockroach Janta Party has also expressed support for the planned march.
The Congress Party had sought a meeting with the Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant to raise the issue of alleged vote theft.
However, the CJI declined the meeting, reportedly citing the matter being sub judice in the Supreme Court.
